modules.title: 把 name 拼成 nmae，会在哪一步发现？
拼错的名称为什么会提前标红

items.title: 同一个拼错
items.text: 代码想读取 name，却写成了不存在的 nmae。

items.title: JavaScript 晚些才知道
items.text: 没有额外检查时，页面运行到这一行才可能读到 undefined，也就是“没有这个值”。

items.title: TypeScript 先提醒
items.text: 它根据你写下的约定在编辑器里标红；随后代码通常会变成 JavaScript 再执行。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 标红值得先修，但它不能证明按钮流程、价格或权限规则真的符合你的产品要求。

lessonPractice.title: 用户资料规定 name 是文字，代码却读取 user.nmae；同时折扣公式把 20% 算成 20 倍。TypeScript 能解决什么？

options.label: 提前发现字段拼写或类型不符，但折扣业务公式仍需测试验证
options.feedback: 类型系统能检查数据形状和使用方式，无法判断一个合法数字是否符合业务含义。

options.label: 只要项目没有类型报错，字段和所有折扣结果就都正确
options.feedback: 通过类型检查不代表逻辑正确，20 和 0.2 都可能是合法数字。

options.label: 把用户资料和价格都标成 any，避免编辑器继续阻止运行
options.feedback: Any 关闭了最需要的结构检查，让拼写和错误用法更晚才暴露。

en.title: A user profile defines name as text, but code reads user.nmae, while a discount formula treats 20% as 20×. What can TypeScript solve?

options.label: Catch misspelled fields and type mismatches early, while business formulas still need tests
options.feedback: Types check data shape and usage, but cannot know whether a valid number carries the correct business meaning.

options.label: If there are no type errors, every field and discount result must be correct
options.feedback: Passing type checks does not prove logic; both 20 and 0.2 can be valid numbers.

options.label: Mark profiles and prices as any so the editor stops blocking execution
options.feedback: Any disables the structural checks needed here and delays spelling and usage failures.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为用户资料和价格数据补齐 TypeScript 类型，消除拼写字段和不一致结构，不要用 any 绕过。类型通过后，再为折扣边界写测试，因为类型不能证明业务公式正确。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Define TypeScript types for profile and price data, remove misspelled fields and inconsistent shapes, and do not bypass them with any. After type checks pass, add discount-boundary tests because types cannot prove the formula.

learning.assumes: You have seen a name in code such as user.name.
learning.outcome: You can tell that a TypeScript error catches a mismatch before runtime, not whether a product rule is correct.

modules.title: Why a misspelled property can be flagged early

items.title: The same typo
items.text: The code asks for `nmae` when the declared property is `name`.

items.title: JavaScript finds out later
items.text: Without an extra check, the page may reach that line and get `undefined` at runtime.

items.title: TypeScript flags the contract
items.text: It compares the code to the types you wrote, usually in the editor, before the code is run.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Fix a type error first, but do not treat a clean type check as proof that pricing, permissions, or button flows meet the product rules.
